name: Gorbushka. The heart of Moscow Rock
overview: The model palace of culture at the aviation plant was built in the late 30s of the last century, but it gained fame and cult status only 50 years later, when two Komsomol members, Igor Tonkikh and Alexander Larin, organized a philophonist club at the Recreation Center. Gradually, a small organization of music lovers turned into the world's largest pirate market, the DC scene opened the doors to the best Russian and Western rock bands, and Gorbushka itself became not just a global hangout and a giant marketplace, but a real window into the world.
